svg.title: CAP Senior Member NCO cap device (service cap and flight cap)
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"cap-device-nco-senior","name":"CAP Senior Member NCO cap device (service cap and flight cap)","size_in":{"w":1.25,"h":1.25},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,125,125],"colours":{"silver":"#bcc1c8","silverL":"#e6e9ed","silverD":"#8f969e","disc":"#d8dce1","navyField":"#0f1f78","rimSilver":"#dfe2e5","red":"#d40f19","redL":"#ec2a33"},"grade":"accessory","anchors":{"top_center":[62.5,0],"bottom_center":[62.5,125],"center":[62.5,62.5],"left_edge":[0,62.5],"right_edge":[125,62.5],"mount_center":[62.5,62.5]},"size_source":"estimated","fit":{"method":"silhouette IoU against the Vanguard listing photo (ink = not white background and not the grey background seen through the openings; 600 x 623 px frame)","score":0.95},"size_basis":"Diameter 1.25 in, estimated: neither CAPR 39-1, ICL 25-02 nor the Vanguard product page (\"Civil Air Patrol Cap Device: NCO Cap Device\", SKU CAP0748R) prints a size. The listed shipping weight, 18 g, equals the officer flight cap device (SKU CAP0748OA, 18 g), which Vanguard prints at 1 1/4 x 1 1/4 in, so the NCO device is drawn 1.25 in across. It is round: the outer ring of the listing photo fits a true circle (radius 294.6 px, residual within 5 px), so height = width (the photo frame is 600 x 623 px only because of its white margins)","provenance":"Traced by measurement from the Vanguard listing photo of the real device (https://www.vanguardmil.com/products/civil-air-patrol-cap-device-nco-cap-device, SKU CAP0748R; reference only, never embedded, scratch copy outside the repo); ref-frame positions: ring circle centre (301,313.8) r 294.6, groove r 276, inner edge r 253; CAP disc centre (301,140) r 83, triangle apex y 61 base y 168 half-width 56, propeller hub (301,139); openings outlined from the photo (background grey seen through the piece); wing primaries pivot (205,265), secondaries pivot (255,335); scroll band (132,146)->(246,208), loop opening centre (250,266) r 15 (mirror-averaged); laurel stem arc r 226 from 95 to 172 deg; left half measured, right half mirrored about x = 301. Cross-checked against ICL 25-02 (Fig A5-8 / A5-9 images of the NCO device)","dimensions":{"diameter_in":1.25,"form":"round pin-on device, openwork","ring":"polished silver, outer band and inner lip","emblem":"CAP disc (ribbed field, triangle, propeller) over a spread-wing eagle holding a scroll, laurel branches below"},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Men's and women's service caps, Senior Member NCOs","rule":"centred on the front of the cap in device_slot_center; no clouds and darts on the visor for NCOs (6.2.1.1.1 and 6.2.1.2.1 as changed by ICL 25-02; 6.2.1.3.3)"},{"uniform":"USAF-style flight cap (Class A / Class B / FDU), Senior Member NCOs","rule":"front left flap, centred halfway between the top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in back from the front of the cap (placement of 6.2.2.2.1-3; ICL 25-02 (g) authorizes the NCO device on the flight cap)"}],"documented":["Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device centred on the front of the service cap (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1 as changed by ICL 25-02)","ICL 25-02 (g) authorizes the CAP NCO Cap Device for wear on the service and flight cap","flight cap devices sit on the front left flap, centred halfway between the top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in from the front (6.2.2.2.1-3)"],"assumed":["diameter 1.25 in (by weight against the 1 1/4 in officer flight device; no printed size)","ICL 25-02 item 8 rewrites 6.2.1.1.1 and 6.2.1.2.1 but leaves the 6.2.2.2.1 sentence \"Senior Member NCOs do not wear a hat device on the flight cap\" in place; the ICL summary (g) authorizes the device on the flight cap, so the ICL is followed (R4) and the officer flight cap placement is used","flat colours: the real piece is polished silver, drawn in two flat silver tones with a thin grey outline","feathers, coverts, breast rows, talons, head and leaves are stylised geometry placed at measured positions, not the relief; leaf count 13 pairs a side","the scroll carries SEMPER VIGILANS on the real piece; drawn as a plain band (no lettering in the art)","the photo is slightly turned and lit from the right; openings measured on the left half and mirrored"]}
